name: br-freelance-intake
description: Prepare a documented intake and handoff for Brazilian self-employed tax work covering calendar year 2026, with a separate historical-year path. Trigger on preparing IRPF, freelancer, autônomo, MEI, Simples Nacional, missing tax documents or assembling a self-employed return package. Read existing records first, extract uploaded evidence, reconcile payer and taxpayer identities, then ask only for facts still missing. Covers mixed employment, business receipts, contributions, deductions, assets, debts and invoice reform routing. Produces a structured package for br-return-assembly without inventing tax paid or treating bank deposits as income. Tax computations stay with their owning Guides. Residence changes, other company regimes and special activities receive component referrals while supported preparation continues. This is an intake method, not permission to file, pay or make an election.
